solver.kind: blind AI solver (separate agent, answer-free packet, rubric v2)

Q079-01.notes: Line y=2x-2. Below: c < 2c-2 -> c > 2. C (c<2) is the sign-flip trap; A, D are weaker distractors.

Q079-02.notes: Slope (a-b)/(b-a) = -1, so f(x) = -x + k; f(a)=b gives k=a+b, so f(0)=a+b. D gives f(a+b)=0, not a+b; B and C are false. Students can test numbers (a=1, b=2). At the hard/medium boundary.

flags: minor: backsolving from the choices is quick (30 -> 15 -> 10 -> 22 = 30 - 8)
Q079-03.notes: x/2 people remain, then (2/3)(x/2) = x/3; x/3 + 12 = x - 8 gives x = 30. All choices are divisible by 6, so there is no divisibility shortcut.

Q079-04.notes: The mean is (6x+6)/3 = 2x+2, which never equals 2x+3, so no solution.

flags: minor: 18 g per marble is heavy for a marble (typical glass marbles weigh about 5 g); plausible only for large marbles
minor: 'filled with glass marbles' implies the first box's marbles are not glass; acceptable but slightly odd wording
Q079-05.notes: Each marble weighs 18 g and the box 240 g. The new marble weighs 27 g and the box is unchanged: W = 27n + 240. A scales the box weight too (trap).

Q079-07.notes: Each 12-min cycle fills 400 bottles. After 4 cycles (48 min) 1600 are filled; 200 more take 5 min, so 53. Traps: 45 (ignoring stops), 51, 50.

Q079-08.notes: n >= 36. 3n+4 is even iff n is even: 36..50 even gives 8 values, 8/50 = 4/25. B = odd count (7/50), D = all n >= 36 (15/50).

Q079-09.notes: Sugar 300 means 2 parts = 300, so 1 part = 150. Flour 750 (+250), butter 450 (+150), total 400.

Q079-10.notes: |49 - w| <= 0.02w gives 49/1.02 <= w <= 49/0.98, so 48.04 <= w <= 50.00. A (+/-2% of the reading) is the strong trap; C mixes the two bounds; D is +/-2 kg.

Q079-11.notes: A = 1.25*0.7C = 0.875C, so C/A = 1.1429, i.e. 14.3%. B (12.5%) uses C as the base (trap); A = 30 - 25; D is another miscalculation.

Q079-12.notes: y = 3x in B. A is linear but not proportional; C breaks at (4, 9); D is not linear.
